author: Home RenoVision DIY
description:
On a hot day, twisted deck joists can be a lot easier to work with if you know this trick. I hose the framing down with water to help make the wood more flexible, so I can pull it into place without splitting it. Simple deck-building tip that can save you a headache.


Watch the full deck blocking video 👉🏼https://youtu.be/Bk2d1WydDR8
title: Twisted Deck Joists? Try This Simple Trick
